propositions: The dedup key is currently derived from a prediction of bytes the send path will produce, rather than from the bytes actually sent, causing drift when three independently-maintained fit compositions diverge
The outbound comment dedup key must be derived from wire_body (the exact bytes the transport receives) so it is immune to changes in how fit is composed across the differ and adapters
Both mutation-enactment consumers (dispatch_one.py create path and dispatch_apply_phases.py update path) must send wire_body from the mutation entry, with fallback to body for pre-cutover entries
The adapter's fit must remain idempotent so that re-fitting an already-fitted body returns it byte-identical, guaranteeing the key cannot move after being taken

fit_for_send must return a FittedComment dataclass containing both landed_text (for keying) and wire_body (for sending), replacing the current three-way composition drift with a single unified derive point
